display_long_description:
Fear Reality is a fast-paced multiplayer Gorilla Tag fan game that throws you into a massive underground laboratory where an experiment has gone horribly wrong. Using fluid, skill-based gorilla-style movement, you’ll run, climb, leap, and wall-jump through eerie hallways, shattered observation rooms, and darkened test chambers while something hunts you from the shadows.

The lab is no longer safe. Sudden lockdowns can seal doors, split players apart, and trap you with whatever is lurking inside. Power failures plunge entire sections into darkness, forcing you to rely on your instincts as monsters roam freely. Break through fragile glass barriers to escape danger, create new paths, or ambush your friends in chaotic multiplayer moments.

Survive together or fall alone. Build bases with friends to hide, plan, or make a last stand against the creatures stalking the facility. Every match is unpredictable, filled with tense chases, close calls, and moments of pure panic as the environment reacts to your presence.

But Fear Reality isn’t just about running. Hidden areas, strange rooms, and unexplained events hint at a deeper mystery buried within the lab. The more you explore, the more reality itself seems to distort. The question isn’t what happened here — it’s whether you’ll escape before it happens again.

Enter the lab. Break the glass. Run from the truth.
Fear Reality awaits.
